messages.subject: EventEmitter memory leak
parts:

I've noticed that my shiny-server crashes from time to time (see below), which results in some applications "taking too long to respond" while others continue to work normally. Does anyone has any idea what's going on?

This happens approximately once every 1-2 week, this is the second or third time it happened.

Many thanks!

messages.author: 120aaddd58a60b60
messages.subject: Re: EventEmitter memory leak
parts:
Hi Jeff, and thanks for looking into this.

I'm on Shiny Server v0.3.5 (Node.js v0.10.4).

I have 7 apps deployed, all are small dashboard-type reports. I would say I have less then 20 users in total, shouldn't get more than 50 visits a day or so. I would expect the workload to be relatively low.

Most of the apps use RJDBC to connect to MS SQL server (which is hosted on a different machine), and these queries can sometimes take 20-30 seconds to load, although we try to cache everything locally as much as we can.

I looked at shiny-server and noticed that the latest version is 0.4.0. I will try to update to see if the error gets away.
